style: Korean low-poly buildings with five replaceable blank signs
geometryPolicy: Only Signage subtree modified; blade artwork exposed on both sides

signs.name: Sign_Main_01
signs.replacementGuidance: Assign an individual material to the named Board mesh. Retain anchor transform and dimensions. Artwork front is local -Y; local X is width and local Z is height. Opaque base color texture; no resizing of facade or door objects.
